list: Leonida Field Guide: the complete single-player platinum route

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies across Leonida to receive the platinum automatically. Use the checklist to find unfinished story, collection and activity goals.

roadmap.note: The last unlock follows completion of every other checklist entry.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing through its final objective. This opening mission awards its trophy through normal story progress.

roadmap.note: Start the campaign and finish the opening assignment.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the campaign beyond Chapter 1 and finish What's in the Bag? at the start of Chapter 2. Before moving on, protect the optional Lucia meditation described under Positive Mental Attitude.

roadmap.note: Check the early meditation safeguard before crossing the chapter boundary.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Follow the main missions out of Chapter 2 into Welcome to Vice City. Complete that Chapter 3 introduction to trigger this chapter trophy.

roadmap.note: Continue through the transition into Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Advance beyond Chapter 3 and complete Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4. The chapter award arrives through this story transition.

roadmap.note: Keep playing through Chapter 4's opening missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's remaining main missions, including Starting From Zero. This chapter trophy is awarded as part of the final story progression.

roadmap.note: Finish the late campaign rather than stopping at the chapter title.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: See Jason and Lucia's main story through Starting From Zero. Finish the last mission to earn the campaign's gold trophy.

roadmap.note: Clear the finale before concentrating on the completion checklist.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish every objective in Breakfast Run during Chapter 2. The mission awards this trophy as the story advances.

roadmap.note: Earn this while following Chapter 2's main route.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3, including its escape objectives. This award belongs to the main campaign rather than the optional bank-vault robberies.

roadmap.note: Complete this named heist on the main story route.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play Child's Play to completion during Chapter 4. Stay with the main mission chain until the game confirms the mission is finished.

roadmap.note: Follow the Chapter 4 campaign objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners as you work through Chapter 4. Finish the mission itself; the trophy does not ask for an additional free-roam task.

roadmap.note: Let the Chapter 4 story lead you to this mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Keep this story objective separate from the optional airport departure trophy, Catch Me If You Can.

roadmap.note: Finish the campaign assignment at the airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow Chapter 3's story to Operation Savage Glory and complete its objectives. The trophy is tied to the mission's completion.

roadmap.note: Continue the main route through this late story operation.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work through the listed requirements. Use that in-game list to decide which remaining Leonida activities contribute to this gold trophy.

roadmap.note: Use the completion menu as your checklist after the finale.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Accumulate 250 registered Stunts around Leonida. Check the game's Stunts total between sessions so ordinary driving does not get mistaken for credited progress.

roadmap.note: Finish the outstanding Stunts once travel is unrestricted.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity category you encounter in Leonida. Keep a short record of the different types tried so revisiting a familiar activity does not replace a missing category.

roadmap.note: Try unfamiliar activity icons while moving between missions.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the Shooting Range and earn gold in every challenge, including each weapon category. Revisit lower medals and focus practice on the targets or timing that cost the most points.

roadmap.note: Return for the full gold-medal sweep after learning the shooting controls.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun Drone Race at each location across Leonida. Record locations already won and practice tight turns before attempting another full race.

roadmap.note: Sweep the drone venues and check that each visit ended in a win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Build a list of 20 distinct race wins around Leonida. Move to a new event after each victory because repeated wins in one race do not satisfy the different-races requirement.

roadmap.note: Count different events rather than total victories.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Accept Cal's fishing challenge and finish ahead of him under the challenge rules. Watch the fishing prompts carefully and complete the contest rather than leaving after a good catch.

roadmap.note: Take a fishing break when Cal's challenge becomes available.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade machine in Leonida and play its game through to completion. Starting a round alone is not enough, so stay until the game records a finished run.

roadmap.note: Finish an arcade game during an early activity visit.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's optional mission strand to its last assignment and finish it. If the next assignment is unavailable, advance other tasks and check back for the strand's continuation.

roadmap.note: Close Andy's strand while clearing optional character missions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through its final job. Track the whole sequence so an earlier completed assignment is not mistaken for the end of his story.

roadmap.note: Finish Kenton's remaining assignments during the strand cleanup.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's optional assignments until his final mission is complete. Return to his available missions between other Leonida objectives to keep the strand moving.

roadmap.note: Complete Billy's entire sequence before marking this entry earned.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands in Leonida, checking the trophy tracker after each finale. Not every optional character counts as a stranger, so use the tracker to confirm credited strands.

roadmap.note: Track qualifying stranger finales separately from other optional missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List after the Chapter 3 car-theft introduction. Check his outstanding requests before stealing another sports car and deliver the requested vehicles to his Vice City garage.

roadmap.note: Check Randy's outstanding vehicles while finishing character strands.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's lab-destruction strand after Here, Kitty Kitty. Complete Take Out Kitty Litter and then the follow-up Spin On This to finish his sequence.

roadmap.note: Use Jason to close Tyrone's lab-related assignments.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Before leaving Chapter 1, take Lucia's optional meditation at Jason's house: after Down to Earth, speak to her in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. Treat this as missable insurance because its necessity for the trophy remains unconfirmed. Then visit Leonida's meditation spots with both characters where available and finish the final meditation when it appears.

roadmap.note: Protect the Chapter 1 opportunity first, then return for the remaining meditation locations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting requests as Jason and bring back the requested animals. Continue through his Target Deck objectives until the unique-animal trophy registers; the precise triggering animal is still being confirmed.

roadmap.note: Work through Bret's requests alongside the completion checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card belonging to three complete sets. Focus your Leonida search on missing cards within those sets rather than accumulating unrelated singles.

roadmap.note: Finish three sets before widening the card search.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to scan environmental points of interest until 100 locations are credited. Include landmarks, curiosities and sculptures while exploring Leonida; vehicle discoveries belong to a separate trophy.

roadmap.note: Scan points of interest during the regional collection sweep.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Check Progress, then Challenges for completed objectives and choose unfinished ones that suit your play style. Reach 50 completed challenges; leave awkward objectives for later while easier categories remain.

roadmap.note: Review incidental challenge progress before choosing additional objectives.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, bring your partner along, reach four wanted stars and escape both the police search and red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia helps break helicopter sightlines.

roadmap.note: Attempt this once Jason and Lucia can travel together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner and rob three shops while keeping the active police pursuit alive. Try the jewelry stores in north Vice City and allow a short delay after the third robbery for the award.

roadmap.note: Plan a short route through several shops before starting the pursuit.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan new vehicle models with WAiNK until 100 discoveries register. Include boats and aircraft while exploring Leonida instead of searching only road traffic.

roadmap.note: Scan unfamiliar models throughout the campaign to reduce later searching.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill Focus, gather five gang enemies in view and activate Combat Focus while aiming by pressing both sticks. Use an accurate rifle and finish all five before that activation ends.

roadmap.note: Look for a grouped set of gang enemies during combat objectives.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a passenger jet attached to a boarding bridge, such as E3/E4. Back out, take off and fly roughly a kilometre away; jets parked separately on the airfield do not qualify.

roadmap.note: Save before entering VCIA and use a jet connected to a terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Visit Mile Zero Air Station on Mariana County's southwestern island and take a tank from the base's southern end. Fire on enemies from inside the stolen tank until the trophy registers.

roadmap.note: Prepare for a military-base incursion during miscellaneous cleanup.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's rear door. Find the safe code, take the money, disable the alarm and erase security footage before leaving unseen.

roadmap.note: Approach a jewelry robbery quietly after obtaining the Snap Gun.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Unlock bank jobs through That's Where The Money Is, then rob five vaults with your partner and escape each time. Follow security vans to reach vaults while they are open.

roadmap.note: Pair vault robberies with the escape and laundering goals.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, open its rear doors with sticky bombs and take the cash. Escape the police afterward so the robbery ends successfully.

roadmap.note: Carry explosives so a passing truck can become a completed robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the unexplored fog across Leonida's map. Fly over remaining gaps and check offshore areas before repeating roads you have already explored.

roadmap.note: Use the remaining map fog to direct an aerial exploration pass.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for every gang in Leonida. Note the gang attached to each completed operation so repeat attacks on the same faction do not hide a missing gang.

roadmap.note: Prioritize operations owned by gangs absent from your completed list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean Beach's Ocean View Rooftop Bar and order an Apple Martini. Drink it beside the bar to complete this Vice City callback.

roadmap.note: Stop at the rooftop bar while clearing Ocean Beach objectives.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Once the Key Cloner is available in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee from the southern Vice City showroom. Drive through the showroom glass; a different display car will not qualify.

roadmap.note: Return to the showroom with the Key Cloner ready.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During the optional Chapter 2 job at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, collect all three valuables and bring sticky bombs for the safe. You can return later for anything left behind.

roadmap.note: Check the bowling-alley valuables when finishing optional jobs.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After partner outings unlock in Chapter 2, take Jason and Lucia to a fitness club together. Train until both Strength meters are full; bringing the partner lets both characters benefit from each visit.

roadmap.note: Include regular workouts in partner outings instead of leaving all training until last.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Accumulate 500 actions that affect your criminal profile while completing robberies and encounters. Enable Criminal Profile HUD notifications to see which actions register, and check the trophy counter before doing extra cleanup.

roadmap.note: Let normal campaign and robbery actions build this counter first.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After Credit Check in Chapter 3, return alone as Lucia to the Little Cuba Payday Loans store from the prologue. Empty its three cash drawers and escape on foot; using a getaway vehicle prevents this trophy.

roadmap.note: Use Lucia alone and plan an escape route that needs no vehicle.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Go alone after 2 AM to the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car. Follow the woodland path toward the UFO, help the woman it releases and return to her car; revisit the area if the encounter has not spawned.

roadmap.note: Leave a nighttime solo outing for the roadside UFO encounter.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a bike through a busy Vice City street and press Square to kick nearby pedestrians. Hit ten within sixty seconds; Ocean Beach offers a useful concentration of targets.

roadmap.note: Choose a busy stretch before starting the timed bike-melee attempt.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, take marked robbery proceeds to a fence such as Yasmani in Vice City. Launder $250,000 cumulatively; the money does not need to come from one delivery.

roadmap.note: Process marked cash earned during the bank-vault and shop robbery sweep.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a combined $100,000 at Leonida's shops. Buy useful weapons, vehicle modifications and other upgrades first so the spending also supports unfinished activities.

roadmap.note: Check accumulated purchases before spending money solely for the trophy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open Vice City Real Estate on the phone and buy the eight purchasable garages for $160,000 total. Story garages do not replace these purchases.

roadmap.note: Buy garage capacity before registering the final vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Buy enough garage spaces, then take ten eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray followed by Register. Early on, use vehicles without trackers; cheaper cars and bikes keep registration costs down.

roadmap.note: Use the purchased garages to support ten completed registrations.
